title: Owner decides whether HIIT gets its own Classes library filter chip
acceptance: The owner decides whether the Classes library filter adds a HIIT chip beside All, Cycle and Pilates now that the home has a HIIT template card (RF-165). The answer is recorded here; any implementation gets its own record.
Separately from the chip decision, the #678 cleanups are done or explicitly dropped: LIBRARY_TEMPLATES is derived from SCAFFOLD_DISCIPLINES, and DisciplineFilter is typed from ClassTemplate.
nextAction: From the #678 final review (2026-10-31): HIIT classes can only be found under All. #678 kept the filter type separate (DisciplineFilter in ClassesHome.tsx) so cards cannot add chips silently. Agent-created: Backlog until the owner decides.

evidence.summary: Final review of #678 (merged dbcb514), item 1: no HIIT filter chip; plus cleanups (derive LIBRARY_TEMPLATES from SCAFFOLD_DISCIPLINES, tie DisciplineFilter to ClassTemplate).
Final review of #684 tightened: artwork spot excluded from the row toggle, cap covers row taps, one accessible control per row, RF-138 depends on RF-151, RF-170 linked to RF-165.
